hooks.name: Never print secrets
hooks.description: Blocks shell commands that would print API keys, passwords or the database URL into the conversation (cat .env.local, echo $..._KEY). Scripts that read .env.local without printing it are allowed.

hooks.name: Keep the solution out of the browser
hooks.description: After a change under src/, checks that no browser ('use client') file imports truth.ts, the full image manifest, or a server-only module that holds keys.

hooks.name: Test the case after a content change
hooks.description: After a change to the mystery's content, runs that case's tests: fair play, the clue chain, secrecy of pictures and sounds, attacks on the characters, and the property-based order-of-play checks.

hooks.name: Keep .kiro committed
hooks.description: The Kiroween rules require /.kiro in the repository. After .gitignore changes, fails if any part of .kiro has become ignored.
